expectation: A short adaptive search may improve the utility model, but the gain may not survive outer household validation. I expect the loop may correctly stop without replacing the incumbent. No check outcomes, code mutation, API, or GPU.

inputs.next_change: 0.3 if stronger shrinkage was accepted, otherwise 0.001
inputs.keep_rule: Inner-CV log loss must improve by at least 0.002, buy/no-buy loss must not worsen by more than 0.005, and model checks must pass.
inputs.replacement_rule: Do not replace the existing prototype unless the descriptive 95% paired outer-household interval for loss difference is entirely below zero. This criterion does not remove adaptive-research uncertainty.
inputs.scope: Predefined CPU experiments; not an LLM researcher or a guarantee of an optimal model.

loop_minus_incumbent.interpretation: negative favors first model; descriptive bootstrap with fitted predictions held fixed

structural_assumptions: A higher own price cannot increase a cleaner’s modeled purchase probability.
Price sensitivity is shared across cleaners; tight budgets may add a penalty.
Only the entrant’s score responds to its message and online channel.
Product utilities are additive; substitution follows multinomial logit assumptions.
These constraints are modeling assumptions, not established causal findings.
